test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 5 persons J, K, L, M and N are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). N and M are at the extreme ends of the row. K is the immediate neighbour of J and M. L is to the left of J. How many persons are sitting to the right of L?
solution:
**Given: **5 persons J, K, L, M and N are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). 

1. N and M are at the extreme ends of the row. 

2. K is the immediate neighbour of J and M. 

3. L is to the left of J. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e3bceeee90b507a47080bdbecae9a0031511fad2af916dbaea515286941be11.png] 

Thus, 3 persons are sitting to the right of L.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
